thread:
Alex G: Quick heads-up — marketplace response envelope tweak (v3) will land next month and affects SDK deserialization for ARM wheels. We need a coordinated partner-safe rollout. TLDR: header X-Redwood-ModelVersion removed -> clients must read model_version from body.
Maya L: @Alex G thanks — do we have a compatibility shim? some partners can't update wheels quickly.
Derek H: There's a flag-based shim we can ship in the SDK: COMPAT_LAYER=true reads both header+body. I can PR. It adds ~120 LOC, toggled at runtime.
Sophia P: perfect. what's the plan for enabling by default? partners like CloudX and HWCo need extra runway.
Alex G: Proposal: enable COMPAT_LAYER=true by default for 4 weeks post-launch, then flip off. We run a canary with 5% traffic for week1. Rollout timeline in the doc: https://redwood.internal/partner-compat/rollout-plan
Raj K: Partner test matrix updated -> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/partner-matrix (CloudX: needs wheel rebuild, HWCo: uses vendor SDK pinned to 1.2.0)
Maya L: Communications: I'll draft a short partner note explaining the reason, timeline, and steps. Include migration snippet.
Derek H: Migration snippet for SDK:
```
// old
String model = resp.headers().get("X-Redwood-ModelVersion");
// new
String model = resp.body().optString("model_version");
// shim
if ("true".equals(System.getenv("COMPAT_LAYER"))) { /* fallback to header */ }
```
Alex G: Action items: Derek PR for shim (owner: Derek, due: 1708560000), Maya partner comms (owner: Maya, due: 1708540000), Soph liaise with CloudX PM (owner: Sophia). I'll schedule a partner sync next Tues 10am PT. :calendar:
partner-bot: Reminder scheduled: Partner sync on 2024-02-25 10:00 PT (created by Alex G).
Maya L: Extra ask — can we add telemetry to count how many responses still have header? small metric 'compat.header_present'?
Derek H: yep I'll add a histogram metric and a dashboard tile.
Alex G: Great — let's keep this narrow and executable. If partners hit blockers we'll extend the grace window. :thumbsup:
